raw.description: 回合开始时，若自身体力高于1/2则当回合免疫受到的麻痹状态，免疫成功则消除对手的回合类效果与能力提升效果|自身被击败时，若本次在场自身受到过麻痹状态，则己方下只出战精灵本场战斗免疫麻痹状态|（boss无效）
raw.analyze_desc: [sprite name=dot4][color=#57c975]回合开始时[/color]，若自身体力高于1/2则[color=#52a5f2]当回合[/color]免疫受到的[color=#57c975]麻痹[/color]状态，免疫成功则消除对手的[color=#52a5f2]回合类效果[/color]与能力提升效果|[sprite name=dot4]自身被[color=#57c975]击败[/color]时，若本次在场自身受到过[color=#57c975]麻痹[/color]状态，则[color=#52a5f2]己方[/color]下只[color=#52a5f2]出战[/color]精灵本场战斗免疫[color=#57c975]麻痹[/color]状态

review.rationale: 原文明示己方下只出战精灵，不能以当前对手代替。
review.singleBehavior: 回合开始严格高半免麻痹与成功清回合清强；实际麻痹准入记录、死亡继承条件已实现验证。
review.deferredBehavior: 实际下一只己方出场获得本场永久免麻痹，换宠重建本次在场记录。
review.trigger: 自身被击败且本次在场实际受到过麻痹。
futureMechanisms: 队伍与真实下一只出场
跨精灵永久免疫状态传递
再次登场在场记录生命周期

dependencyEvidence.quote: 则己方下只出战精灵本场战斗免疫麻痹状态

review.reviewedBy: Codex source, latest user answer and concrete state assertions review

success.name: 4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹
success.assertion: test('4940回合开始严格高半体免麻痹且成功清敌回合与强化，恰半不免并记录实际麻痹',()=>{for(const hp of[4500,4501]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp});s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,hp===4500);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,hp===4500?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],hp===4500);}});

success.name: 4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦
success.assertion: test('4940麻痹免疫取回初快照，途中低体仍免、途中回高体不会追授，非麻痹不拦',()=>{for(const high of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp:high?9000:1000});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1){if(high)c.hurt(c.t,7000,'回初快照降体','direct');else c.heal(c.t,9000,'回初快照回体','soul');c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);}},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],!high);}const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'中毒',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.ok(s.fighters[0].ailments['中毒']);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,false);});

success.name: 4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合
success.assertion: test('4940自身来源麻痹被免时清除真正对手，不能错误清自己的强化与回合',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].stages.atk=2;s.fighters[1].stages.atk=2;observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===0)c.ailment(c.a,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.atk,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,0);assert.ok(s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中']);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects['攻击必中'],undefined);});

success.name: 4940初始入场发生的麻痹真实记录，不把尚未开始的回合免疫提前执行
success.assertion: test('4940初始入场发生的麻痹真实记录，不把尚未开始的回合免疫提前执行',()=>{const s=observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='battleStart'&&c.a.side===1)c.entryAilment(c.t,'麻痹',3,c.a);},()=>make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true}));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].ailments['麻痹'],3);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.seenParalysis,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardian2140.immuneRound,0);});

success.name: 4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强
success.assertion: test('4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强',()=>{for(const reflect of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(reflect)timer(s,0,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,reflect?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],reflect);}});

success.name: 4940被实际击败仅在本次入场曾实际麻痹时登记下只永久免麻痹，不赋给当前对手
success.assertion: test('4940被实际击败仅在本次入场曾实际麻痹时登记下只永久免麻痹，不赋给当前对手',()=>{for(const hp of[1,9000]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{spe:10,def:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spe:1000}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].soulState.guardianInheritance2140,hp===1);if(hp===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardianInheritance2140.requiresActualNextAlly,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.guardianInheritance2140,undefined);}});

interaction.name: 4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强
interaction.assertion: test('4940自身魂印免麻痹不消次数，已有回合反弹优先时不冒充魂印清强',()=>{for(const reflect of[false,true]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true});s.fighters[0].counts.immune=1;s.fighters[1].stages.def=2;if(reflect)timer(s,0,'reflect');observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,20309));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].counts.immune,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.def,reflect?2:0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹'],reflect);}});

interaction.name: 4940被实际击败仅在本次入场曾实际麻痹时登记下只永久免麻痹，不赋给当前对手
interaction.assertion: test('4940被实际击败仅在本次入场曾实际麻痹时登记下只永久免麻痹，不赋给当前对手',()=>{for(const hp of[1,9000]){const s=make({move:10001,index:-1,soul:true,hp,aStats:{spe:10,def:1},bStats:{atk:9999,spe:1000}});observe((e,c)=>{if(e==='beforeUse'&&c.a.side===1)c.ailment(c.t,'麻痹',c.a,false,false,3);},()=>turn(s,10001,10127));assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,0);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[0].soulState.guardianInheritance2140,hp===1);if(hp===1)assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.guardianInheritance2140.requiresActualNextAlly,true);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.guardianInheritance2140,undefined);}});

success.assertion: test('4940基础4/5真实等级与边界，10两招5%麻痹成功失败，585两组参数保持逐项不同',()=>{for(const id of[4,5])for(const item of rows(id)){const s=make(item),side=id===4?0:1,k=keys[item.args[0]];turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[side].stages[k],item.args[2]);const p=make(item);p.fighters[side].stages[k]=item.args[2]>0?6:-6;turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[side].stages[k],item.args[2]>0?6:-6);}for(const item of rows(10)){const seen=new Set;for(let seed=1;seed<=64;seed++){const s=make({...item,seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);seen.add(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['麻痹']);}assert.deepEqual(seen,new Set([true,false]));}for(const item of rows(585)){const s=make(item);turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.deepEqual(keys.map(k=>s.fighters[0].stages[k]),item.args);}});

success.assertion: test('4940/982流血概率按正级种类增加，每种5%不是每级；1605超频100%仍受真实免疫',()=>{const outcomes=[0,0];for(let seed=1;seed<=40;seed++)for(const group of[0,1]){const s=make({...row(982),seed:Math.imul(seed,2654435761)>>>0});if(group)for(const k of keys)s.fighters[0].stages[k]=6;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);outcomes[group]+=Number(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['流血']);}assert.ok(outcomes[0]>0&&outcomes[0]<40);assert.ok(outcomes[1]>outcomes[0]&&outcomes[1]<40);for(const immune of[false,true]){const s=make(row(1605));if(immune)s.fighters[1].counts.immune=1;turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].ailments['超频'],!immune);}});

success.name: 1213正式兼容：4940真实来源保留正常、免攻零伤、封命中、MISS及整招无效的实际用招，控制药剂不触发且到期
success.assertion: test('1213正式兼容：4940真实来源保留正常、免攻零伤、封命中、MISS及整招无效的实际用招，控制药剂不触发且到期',()=>{for(const mode of ['normal','immune','hit-block','miss','invalid','control','potion']){const s=grant(),m=s.moveDefinitions[key(38516)],pp=s.fighters[0].pp[key(38516)];if(mode==='immune')s.fighters[1].counts.attackNullify=1;if(mode==='hit-block')timer(s,0,'技能命中效果失效');if(mode==='miss'){delete s.fighters[0].effects['攻击必中'];m.alwaysHit=false;m.accuracy=0;}if(mode==='invalid')timer(s,0,'skillBlock');if(mode==='control')s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫']=3;if(mode==='potion')turn(s,null,20309);else turn(s,38516,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),['control','potion'].includes(mode)?0:2250,mode);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(38516)],pp-(['control','potion'].includes(mode)?0:1),mode);delete s.fighters[0].ailments['疲惫'];delete s.fighters[0].effects.skillBlock;delete s.fighters[0].effects['技能命中效果失效'];m.alwaysHit=true;m.accuracy=100;s.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(s,38516,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0,mode+' expires');}});

success.name: 1213正式兼容：同源重授刷新两回合不翻倍，旧真实3667来源重授清除限定标记并保留旧命中门槛及1/3参数
success.assertion: test('1213正式兼容：同源重授刷新两回合不翻倍，旧真实3667来源重授清除限定标记并保留旧命中门槛及1/3参数',()=>{const s=grant();turn(s,37732,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),2250);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].effects[effectKey].end,3);s.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(s,38516,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),2250);s.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(s,38516,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),0);const q=grant(),legacy=require(path.join(root,'data/species/3667.json')).snapshot,m=legacy.moves.find(x=>x.id===26259),compiled=E.WIKI.effectsEngine.compileInstances(m.effectInstances,legacy.effects,m);assert.equal(compiled.issue,'');const op=compiled.operations.find(x=>x.effectId===1213);assert.deepEqual(op.sourceArgs,[4,3]);E.WIKI.effectsEngine.run('afterHit',[op],{a:q.fighters[0],t:q.fighters[1],m,round:q.round,timed(f,k,n,data,start=q.round){f.effects[k]={start,end:start+n-1,...data};}});assert.equal(q.fighters[0].effects[effectKey].actualUseSource1213,undefined);assert.equal(q.fighters[0].effects[effectKey].fraction,1/3);timer(q,0,'技能命中效果失效');turn(q,38516,20309);assert.equal(sum(q,'percent'),0);delete q.fighters[0].effects['技能命中效果失效'];q.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(q,38516,20309);assert.equal(sum(q,'percent'),3000);});

success.name: 1213正式兼容：4940真实ID版本索引参数严格校验，已答来源允许存储且错误仍拒绝，只读验证不改本地快照

success.assertion: test('4940/2492双方盾罩合计正数相等才当回合封属，全部被清，不相等与零对零不封',()=>{for(const equal of[false,true]){const s=make(row(2492));S.refresh(s.fighters[0],10,'a');S.refresh(s.fighters[1],20,'b');S.refreshBarrier(s.fighters[0],equal?30:29,'c');turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);for(const f of s.fighters){assert.equal(f.suitState.shield??0,0);assert.equal(f.suitState.barrier??0,0);}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,equal?0:1);assert.equal(!!s.fighters[1].soulState.noVoluntarySwitch2492,equal);if(equal)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.noVoluntarySwitch2492.requiresRealSwitch,true);}const s=make(row(2492));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20117);assert.equal(s.round,2);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(s.auditMoveId)],4);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages.atk,1);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].effects.statusBlock,undefined);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].soulState.noVoluntarySwitch2492,undefined);});

success.name: 4940/2161真实用招全弱且免弱失败授后两攻100%增伤，整招无效仍触发监听
success.assertion: test('4940/2161真实用招全弱且免弱失败授后两攻100%增伤，整招无效仍触发监听',()=>{const s=make(row(2161));turn(s,s.auditMoveId,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],-1);timer(s,0,'skillBlock');turn(s,38516,20309);for(const k of keys)assert.equal(s.fighters[1].stages[k],-2);const p=make(row(2161));timer(p,1,'免弱');turn(p,p.auditMoveId,20309);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,2);p.moveDefinitions[key(38516)].operations=[];turn(p,38516,20309);assert.ok(sum(p)>0);assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,2);turn(p,null,20309);const damage=[];for(const n of[1,0,0]){turn(p,38516,20309);damage.push(sum(p));assert.equal(p.fighters[0].counts.nextAttackBoost,n);}assert.ok(damage[0]>damage[2]*1.6&&damage[1]>damage[2]*1.6);});
